properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathMat object.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns an OMathMatRows object that represents the rows in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: Cols
properties.description: Returns an OMathMatCols collection that represents the columns in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: Cell
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents a cell in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: Align
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathVertAlignType constant that represents the vertical alignment for a matrix. Read/write.

properties.name: PlcHoldHidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether placeholders in a matrix are hidden from display. True hides placeholder text. Read/write.

properties.name: RowSpacingRule
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathSpacingRule constant that represents the spacing rule for rows in a matrix. Read/write.

properties.name: RowSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the spacing for rows in a matrix. Read/write.

properties.name: ColSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the spacing for columns in a matrix. Read/write.

properties.name: ColGapRule
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathSpacingRule constant that represents the spacing rule for the space that appears between columns in a matrix. Read/write.

properties.name: ColGap
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the spacing between columns in a matrix. Read/write.
